column3: Close to the Hebrew.

The legal image repeats pleading my plea.
Not seeking is expressed as completed.
The mercies are numerous.

The head of Your word is truth, retaining the image of a head.

There is no stumbling block for them, rather than an explicit statement of inability to cause stumbling.
